notes: P2 and P9 are section headers ('Suggestions for improvement') parsed as points and are marked generic/minor. The review did not have access to the supplementary/extended figures, so C10 (readability of SI Lorentzian fits) is marked partly matched via the review's requests for fit uncertainties on the peak positions and velocities (P5, P15, P16). C23 and C5 are marked partly matched by P11 and P22, which catch the reversed ordering of separations at x=0.05 vs x=0.15 and ask to compare the q-vector distortions across the two dopings.
